records.verbatim: The framework proposes that States link data centre approvals to verified electricity, water and infrastructure availability
records.notes: Event date from the GKToday page (framework released 14 Oct 2026). Outlook (2026-10-15) and Indian Express independently describe it as guidance states apply, not a new national approval rule. Principles tags are curator-assigned; the primary-source NITI PDF was not fetched. Stronger primary source is still needed.

records.verbatim: Chhattisgarh CM Vishnu Deo Sai said that these commitments are a vote of confidence in Chhattisgarh's policies, potential and people
records.notes: Investment-invitation stage only, with no land, approval or financing confirmed. Outlook gives the total as Rs 41,750 crore; other outlets say Rs 43,250 crore (includes a Rs 1,500 cr solar/storage pledge from a second firm). Use the Rs 41,750 cr figure for the data-centre line only. Company is a candidate, not yet a companies.json slug.

fields.claim_type: first-party press release quote (Colt DCS Country Head, India)

records.verbatim: Mumbai 3 is designed to address these needs, further strengthening our Navi Mumbai Campus as a scalable and future-ready digital infrastructure platform
records.notes: First-party: a Colt DCS spokesperson quoted in the company press release, carried by W.Media. Commercial/capacity claim, not a community-impact claim, so it is a weak fit for the gate-2 test. Included as a company-capacity record only. Other verified facts from the same page: 64 MW, ground prep from December 2025, a fully pre-let hyperscale customer, part of a US$1.7bn JV with RMZ. The customer is unnamed. Colt DCS is a company candidate. Colt's own site did not load (403), so the release was read via W.Media.

records.verbatim: called activists' concerns about the project incorrect and misleading
records.notes: A government statement, not a community finding. The same report quotes the state: 'Such protests are their democratic right.' Pair it with the Jal Biradari response below. Read the stance field as the state's position on the project, not a neutral finding.

records.verbatim: Jal Biradari (Water Community), which says the project will strain water availability by putting stress on a nearby reservoir
records.notes: Activist-group allegation, reported by Reuters. It is not an independent measurement. The AP High Court PIL hearing was set for 24 Aug 2026 and its outcome was not verified. The existing seed already has the 2026-08-24 PIL response, so check for overlap before filing.
